title: Hotels Near Piyavate Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 6 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 6 closest hotels to Piyavate Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Piyavate, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 6 closest stays to Piyavate, with real distances and prices.
intro: The area around Piyavate runs along New Phetchaburi Road, linking into Soi Soonvijai (Soi 47) and RCA, with the hospital itself beside Khlong Saen Saep. It's easy to reach by train or car: Rama 9 MRT and Phetchaburi MRT are about 5–10 minutes away by vehicle, and if you don't want to walk far, a motorbike taxi or a short taxi hop works. Most hotels here have parking, and many have in-room kitchens because they're built for long stays and patient families. Nearby you'll find convenience stores, restaurants, and Central Rama 9 and Fortune Town not far off. It suits people in for a check-up, outpatients, and families making frequent trips to and from the hospital. The RCA side gets lively with nightlife at night, so if you want a quiet rest, pick somewhere deeper into Soi Soonvijai.

blocks.html: Short answer: Piyavate sits on New Phetchaburi Road beside Khlong Saen Saep, close to RCA and Rama 9, and several hotels are within a few hundred metres on foot. For the closest option with a kitchen, Maitria Hotel Rama 9 is on the same road as the hospital (from about ฿2,300). For a budget room you can still walk from, look at ZAZZ Urban or Rama9 No.1 (from about ฿1,600). For a long stay or recovery with a full kitchen there's Cassia Rama 9 and Chiva Bangkok, and for a quiet boutique with a pool there's Alix Bangkok.

blocks.text: Hotels near Piyavate, by distance & budget

items.name: Maitria Hotel Rama 9 Bangkok - A Chatrium Collection
items.meta: 📍 4-min walk (300 m) to Piyavate · ★ 4-star · Best for: Closest · has a kitchen · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: Sits on the same canal-side road as Piyavate, the hotel at number 908 and the hospital at 998, a few minutes' walk apart. It's a hotel-plus-serviced-apartment where some rooms have a kitchen with a stove and microwave, good for long or post-treatment stays when you want to cook. There's a pool and gym, and reviews praise the location and cleanliness. Best for patient families who want to be as close to the hospital as possible.

items.name: Cassia Rama 9 Bangkok, part of Banyan Group
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (430 m) to Piyavate · ★ 4-star · Best for: Long stays · full kitchen · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer hotel under the Banyan Group in the Rama 9–RCA area, with studios up to two-bedroom suites. Every unit has a full kitchen with an electric stove, fridge, and microwave, plus a living area, and there's a rooftop pool and gym. It's about 430 metres' walk to Piyavate. A fit for families staying several days to care for a patient who want to cook, and reviews praise the cleanliness and room design.

items.name: ZAZZ Urban Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (460 m) to Piyavate · ★ 4-star · Best for: Good value · rooftop bar · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 48-room hotel on New Phetchaburi Road, about 460 metres' walk to Piyavate. Rooms have a fridge, free water, and a kettle, and there's a rooftop bar with city views, free parking, and 24-hour reception. Reviews praise the location, cleanliness, and friendly service. A good pick if you want a decent room at a lower rate that you can still walk to the hospital from.

items.name: Rama9 No.1 Hotel
items.meta: 📍 7-min walk (530 m) to Piyavate · ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · free parking · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel of around 23 rooms off Rama IX Soi 11, about 530 metres' walk to Piyavate. Rooms have a minibar and air conditioning, with free parking and Wi-Fi at a modest rate. Suits anyone in for a hospital visit who just wants a clean bed nearby without spending much, or who drives in and wants easy parking.

items.name: Alix Bangkok Hotel
items.meta: 📍 7-min walk (550 m) to Piyavate · ★ 4-star · Best for: Boutique · has a pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 60-room boutique hotel on Soi Soonvijai 7 off New Phetchaburi Road, about 550 metres from Piyavate. It has a quiet, leafy feel with an infinity pool, a gym, and a kitchenette in some rooms, plus a local shuttle. Reviews praise the large, clean rooms and the calm setting. A fit for anyone who wants a stylish, quiet stay while still being able to walk to the hospital.

items.name: Chiva Bangkok Hotel
items.meta: 📍 9-min walk (650 m) to Piyavate · ★ 3-star · Best for: Good value · in-room kitchenette · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 3-star hotel on Soi Soonvijai 7 off New Phetchaburi Road, about 650 metres from Piyavate. Every room has a balcony and a kitchenette with a fridge, and there's a shuttle and breakfast, set in a quiet, leafy soi. Reviews praise the comfortable beds, cleanliness, and value. A fit for patients and families who want a room with a kitchen on a budget.

faq.q: Are there hotels within walking distance of Piyavate?
faq.a: Yes, several. Most hotels around the hospital are on New Phetchaburi Road and Soi Soonvijai and reach Piyavate in a few minutes. Maitria Hotel Rama 9 is on the same canal-side road as the hospital, about 300 metres away, while Cassia Rama 9 and ZAZZ Urban are an easy walk at around 430–460 metres.

faq.q: How do I get to Piyavate from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: The easiest way is a taxi, about 30–50 minutes depending on traffic. To avoid traffic, take the Airport Rail Link from Suvarnabhumi to Makkasan, change to the MRT, and get off at Phetchaburi or Rama 9, then a short 5–10 minute taxi or motorbike-taxi ride to Piyavate.

faq.q: What kind of stay is best for a multi-day recovery?
faq.a: If you'll be there several days or recovering after treatment, look at a place with an in-room kitchen like Cassia Rama 9, which has a full kitchen, or Maitria Hotel Rama 9 and Chiva Bangkok, which have a kitchenette and fridge so you can cook. It's more comfortable than a single hotel room for longer stays with family helping out.
